reviewed_by: Codex automation command snapshot removal review
reason: Automation run_command no longer recursively scans the linked workspace before and after every command. Four focused runtime tests cover the no-walk regression, normal durable output, generic timeout termination, and the real host subprocess timeout and approval boundary.
exclusions: No frontend, native, Playwright, Docker, VPN, proxy, network-scope, or unrelated backend tests are selected. The API shape and UI are unchanged; workspace_changes remains an empty compatibility field. A real production Core host command is exercised after deployment.
